App details

Ruler & Protractor

Measure small objects and angles with a calibrated ruler and protractor on your screen.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

A calibrated on-screen ruler with metric and imperial scales, plus 0–180° and 0–360° protractor modes for short objects and angles.

Main features

  • Metric and imperial ruler scales.
  • Move markers to measure between two points.
  • Protractor modes from 0–180° and 0–360°.
  • Calibrate against a known length.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

First calibrate the on-screen ruler against a known physical length. Choose centimetres, inches or both, align the object with the screen edge and move two markers to read their difference. For an angle, select the 180- or 360-degree protractor and align its two arms with the edges. Hold keeps the measurement steady.

Important limits

Only short objects that fit the display can be measured directly. A case or inaccurate screen calibration can shift the result. No camera measurement or certified precision is offered.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

The first version uses the screen and touch input without camera or location permission.

Local data

Screen calibration and display preferences would stay locally. Current marker positions are temporary; no measurement history or PDF report is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Camera-background angle measurement is a later candidate, not a first-version feature. Measurement history and reports are also excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
